product_one_liner.value: Multiplier builds custom AI and workflow tools for the tax, accounting and other professional-services firms it acquires, automating time-consuming work so those firms can scale.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer, and no public pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: No qualifying customer page, case study or review listing establishing two customers was found. Named portfolio firms and investors were excluded.

eng_blog.notes: The Ideas index contains strategy, talent and career articles, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about product implementation.

public_docs.notes: The navigation and footer contain no documentation or help-center link; no public product documentation portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the six listed openings has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No product model/provider was disclosed in the technology page, privacy policy, terms, blog or engineering postings reviewed. References to coding tools do not establish the product's runtime provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names UK GDPR in its international-transfer provisions; this is a regulatory-compliance reference, not a formal certification claim.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 4, 2026 Series B falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The only sales opening is Sales & Business Development Associate, not one of the qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive titles.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying product or major-feature launch was found in the requested six-month window. The latest launch announcement found was the company's June 18, 2025 public launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Allen Shim joining as President and CFO was announced on August 4, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Rooled sales role advertised by Multiplier explicitly requires maintaining its HubSpot CRM.
